column1: # Written opt-outs: the PROOF half of a sealing measurement.
# One line per procedure that is allowed to be served clear:
# The rule this file exists for: a keyless advertisement is not a failure by itself,
# because release A lets an operator write `off'. It is a failure when the keyless
# advertisement is not on this list. Nothing may be clear by omission.
# Keep it short. Every entry is a decision someone signed, and the measurement prints
# this file beside its findings so the two are read together.
# No entries yet, and that is correct today: nothing on the fleet has written `off',
# because release A does not exist yet. This file becomes non-empty one line at a time,
# in the PR that makes each decision.
